habitat: Dry and open woodland, deciduous forest, scrub, wooded farmland, forest edges and gardens; open tree cover rather than dense closed forest; 0–1500 m
description: Small ashy-brown woodshrike with a large head, stout slightly hooked bill, broad pale eyebrow above a dark cheek patch and white outer tail feathers; hunts insects in thin forest and scrub, often joining mixed-species flocks.
